text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Brian's whirlwind of a record, Triple Crown
and beyond, continues
into the new year.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
They've passed the final corner into the
last stretch! Narita Brian has
already taken
the lead!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's blasted ahead! Brian's lead is only
growing now!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's unchallenged—no one can catch up
to her six—no, seven-length
lead! And
that's the finish!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
There was never any doubt! Narita Brian's
won the Hanshin Daishoten!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well done, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you made a personal best
time in a long-distance race.
You truly
have no bounds.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You've been chosen as Racer of the Year,
you're winning all these
races...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Daaang, Brian! You're not just making
Team Sirius happy, you're
making the
whole Twinkle Series ecstatic! Keep it up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You're welcome.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Next is the spring Tenno Sho, which
Hayahide won last year. Let's
make it a win
for both siblings!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Next is the spring Tenno Sho, which
Hayahide won last year. Let's
make it a win
for both siblings!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'll win... But first I've got a
winning concert to go to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Everyone says she'll beat President
Rudolf's seven-crown record.
This looks
to be quite a year for Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Everyone, including me, has high
hopes for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm like one of her fans, unable to hold in
my excitement for what
she'll accomplish
next.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Briaaan! Your race was the best today!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
We know you'll win the spring Tenno Sho
too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hwaaa! Brian! So that's how a Triple Crown
winner races!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I wanna soar high in a race like that too!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I had a feeling I'd find you here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sis... How's your leg?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll need a little longer until I've recovered.
I'm starting to get out of
shape.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're doing as well as ever, Racer of the
Year. After that tremendous
victory at the
Hanshin Daishoten, I can't help but
wonder how much
higher you'll soar.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't really have a goal in mind yet. I'm
just trying to finish before
anyone else.
That's all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Your goalpost is ever-moving,
always leaving you hungry
for more.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You do look like you're having fun though.
You really love nothing
more than running.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I look like I'm having fun? Even though I'm
never satisfied by any
race?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Hanshin Daishoten behind her,
Narita Brian is back to
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She needs to be in top shape for her next
big race, the spring Tenno
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Exhale...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: You look a little tired. Everything good?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: You look a little tired. Everything good?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's no problem. I'm not even running at
full strength.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Glad to hear it. Let's play it safe and run
the woodchip course next.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: All right, got it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Brian has the drive to keep running
forever.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
That's what makes her so good. We'd
better raise our expectations to
match her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm excited to see her next race too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same, but we can't simply expect
her to do everything. We
need to follow
her example.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best to make sure she's ready to
perform at her peak.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best to make sure she's ready to
perform at her peak.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The race—isn't it almost the deadline for
Brian to register?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: I think you're right.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh my... It'd be bad to forget that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However good her performance, it's
meaningless if she can't enter the
race.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I'll go right now before I forget. McQueen,
take care of everyone's
traini—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Brian?!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Wh-what happened?!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Wh-what happened?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huff... Wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ugh!
